description: Describes the JS-owned undo/redo stack state for a WYSIWYG editor instance.

members.name: CanRedo
members.description: Whether a redo operation can currently run.

members.name: CanUndo
members.description: Whether an undo operation can currently run.

members.name: Epoch
members.description: Runtime epoch used to discard stale local patches after undo/redo.

members.name: JsOwnedUndo
members.description: Whether the state comes from the JS-owned runtime undo stack.

members.name: LastTransactionId
members.description: Identifier of the latest committed transaction, if any.

members.name: NextRedoDescription
members.description: Description of the next redo operation.

members.name: NextUndoDescription
members.description: Description of the next undo operation.

members.name: PendingTransactionId
members.description: Identifier of the currently open transaction, if any.

members.name: UndoDepth
members.description: Number of undoable transactions, including an open typing transaction.
